AE-08 phase 8 gate/spectral reruns worker (hand record, no --bless). Tree: a0a804a5 plus the cherry-picks 0dd6e693 (9c60b990: a Pause or Stop over a Play keeps the prepared graph wherever the Play has got to; adds hasStartUnderway() and the B6d5 sweep witness), a77ebd28 (8d5f5e82, gate formula) and 2ffa9f53 (5d4b1974, asset marks), plus the spectralPredecessors evidence field and gate case (no product-test change). Measured with `fast-cert.ts --only <780 arms> --jobs 1 --measure` (every non-retired arm whose targets or witnesses touch useTimelinePlayback.ts and its test, native-playback-controller.ts and its test, native-schedule-coordinator.ts, native-timeline-page-manager.ts, ipc-channels.ts or audio-host.cpp, and every row sibling and control): 780 jobs; 34 failed to apply their anchors (below) and were re-measured after re-pointing with `--only` of those 34 (43 jobs with controls): 0 failures. 236 measured fields moved.

(1) Anchors. 9c60b990 (a) put a comment line and an intent-token condition around the superseded-attempt dispose, `if (nativeStart === 'started' && requestedIntentToken === transportIntentToken) { await disposePreparedBackends(...) }`, and (b) replaced `playAttempt !== undefined || rebuildInProgress` in handlePause and the `|| rebuildInProgress` term in handleStop with `hasStartUnderway()` (`playAttemptPhase !== undefined || rebuildInProgress`). Re-pointed, the mutation unchanged in meaning: rows 416, 420 and 421 (and the diag 385/390 plus-416/420/421 cases) carry the new dispose block in both `from` and `to`; rows 434 (Stop) and 437 (Pause) now drop the rebuild term by replacing `hasStartUnderway()` with `playAttemptPhase !== undefined`. 34 arms, 72 spec fields. Every re-pointed arm was checked by applying its changes in order to the file. Five retired arms keep stale anchors (rc2:420:0, rc2:429:0/2/3, rc2:437:1), as retired survivors do.

(2) Counts. HT is 272 pass, 1 skip (270 before, +2 for the B6d5 Pause and Stop sweeps); every control and mutant of an arm that runs the whole file moves by the same delta, so the judge's control-delta rule holds; the hookwit files move +2. 186 pass-count moves, 21 fail-count moves.

(3) Moved killer sets. ledger:439 playback and b6e-witness, rc2:420:1, rc2:421:1 and the 437 arms (rc2:437:0, :2, :3, diag:419:437-alone, diag:419:419-plus-437, diag:434:437-alone-playback, diag:434:434-plus-437-playback) kill with a different set of the same family of witnesses; each still fails at least one test. The new B6d5 sweep is among the killers of 420:1 and 421:1.

(4) Mutants no longer killed. Row 434 (Stop: a rebuild in progress is a start to cancel), re-pointed to drop the rebuild term from handleStop, now exits 0: rc2:434:0:mutant, rc2:434:1:mutant, diag:434:434-repeat-hookwit, diag:434:434-plus-435-hookwit, diag:434:434-plus-436-hookwit, diag:434:434-plus-437-hookwit, diag:434:434-repeat-playback and diag:419:419-plus-434 (row 419 is already a no-witness row). The B6d6 witness that failed the old mutation passes the new one. rc2:434:0 and :1 (and their two controls) retire through retiredArms and are listed in test-debt.md; the diag arms keep their rows. Why no test fails was not investigated; it needs a ruling (a witness for Stop over a rebuild, or proof the term is redundant).
